note.zh-CN: 独立站点尚未上线，资料先看 GitHub 仓库。
note.en: A dedicated docs site is not online yet; start from the GitHub repository.

zh-CN.name: Rezor
zh-CN.tagline: 基于 React 的小程序框架
zh-CN.description: Rezor 用 React Hooks 写小程序，目标是接近原生性能。当前先列在目录里，文档入口是 GitHub 仓库 rezorjs/rezor。
zh-CN.audience: 想在微信小程序里用 React Hooks，并接受资料仍以仓库为主的团队。
useCases: 用 npm create rezor@latest 创建项目
用 React Hooks 编写小程序页面
与 VPT / weapp-vite 对照，而不是当成五层工具链的新一层
capabilities: React Hooks 小程序运行时

faqs.question: 为什么现在没有独立文档站？
faqs.answer: rezor.dev 尚未解析。本目录先指向 GitHub 仓库，站点上线后再更新文档链接。

faqs.question: 它和 VPT 是一回事吗？
faqs.answer: 不是。VPT 把已有 Taro / React 工程的构建切到 Vite。Rezor 是 React 小程序运行时本身。

en.name: Rezor
en.tagline: A React framework for mini programs
en.description: Rezor uses React Hooks to write mini programs, aiming for near-native performance. It is listed in the catalog now; the docs entry is the GitHub repo rezorjs/rezor.
en.audience: Teams who want React Hooks in WeChat mini programs and can work from the repository while the docs site is still landing.
useCases: Scaffold a project with npm create rezor@latest
Write mini-program pages with React Hooks
Compare it with VPT / weapp-vite instead of treating it as a new toolchain layer

faqs.question: Why is there no dedicated docs site yet?
faqs.answer: rezor.dev does not resolve yet. This catalog points at the GitHub repository until a docs site is published.

faqs.question: Is this the same as VPT?
faqs.answer: No. VPT switches an existing Taro / React project's build to Vite. Rezor is a React mini-program runtime.
